arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import semver

# Test edge cases
# 1. VersionInfo.isvalid should be a static method
import inspect
print('isvalid is static method:', isinstance(inspect.getattr_static(semver.VersionInfo, 'isvalid'), staticmethod))

# 2. The regex captures all standard formats
import re
regex = semver._REGEX
tests = [
    ('0.0.0', True),
    ('1.2.3', True),
    ('1.2.3-rc.1', True),
    ('1.2.3+build.1', True),
    ('1.2.3-rc.1+build.1', True),
    ('1.2.3-alpha', True),
    ('1.2.3-alpha.beta', True),
    ('1.2.3-0', True),  # numeric prerelease
    ('1.2.3-0.0', True),
    ('1.2.3-x.7.z.92', True),
    ('01.2.3', False),  # leading zero in major
    ('1.02.3', False),  # leading zero in minor
    ('1.2.03', False),  # leading zero in patch
    ('1.2.3-01', False),  # leading zero in numeric prerelease
    ('1.2.3-rc.01', False),  # leading zero in prerelease identifier
    ('invalid', False),
    ('1.2.3.4', False),
]
for version, expected in tests:
    result = regex.match(version) is not None
    status = 'OK' if result == expected else 'FAIL'
    if status == 'FAIL':
        print(f'{status}: {version!r} expected {expected} got {result}')
print('Regex tests done')
"
